scope: Focused network-only checkpoint. No sixth-wave checkpoint is used as validation evidence. Old hashes are used only to verify untouched files.
runtime: pure Go; no added dependency, native binding or subprocess fallback

api.legacy_signatures: NewGraph/NewDiGraph and Options fields unchanged; DiGraph inherits Graph methods
api.curved: No new topology mutation methods; private wrapper and original guards unchanged

checks.note: Central runner always supplies -tags noasm; includes old Graph/curved tests and new mutation tests.
Development instrumentation uses CGO1; product stays CGO0.

checks.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=386 go build -tags noasm ./network

checks.stage: Central overlay before promotion; final production bytes unchanged. Transient machine-specific overlay removed after promotion. Reproduce on delivered source by omitting -overlay.

checks.note: Development-only actual pinned source calls; ordinary tests read JSON.

reference.matched: Stable vertex/edge/neighbor ordering, explicit positions, selected axis-aligned endpoints, source survivor identity and removal/root/dictionary cleanup. Go atomic transactions separately tested.
differences: Go transactions reject unknown/duplicate endpoints atomically; source can partially apply or auto-create endpoints.
Go preserves edge-first root child ordering; Manim appends submobjects in method call order.
Go has no background updater or implicit mutation animation.
Go newly added directed links always have arrowheads.
reference.license: Reference MIT notice retained in tests/data/network/mutation_reference.md

pixels.comparison: Captured interior frame remains pixel-identical after subsequent graph topology authoring; a fresh scene capture sees changed topology. Concurrent old-scene samples remain independent.

benchmarks.workload: 16 circular-layout vertices, 16 directed cycle edges, scale 3. Round trip: add 8 explicit dots, add 8 links, remove the 8 links, remove the 8 dots.
benchmarks.caveat: Bounded shared-host short observations; no before/after speed claim or whole-library comparison.

boundaries: Simple legacy graphs only; no self-loops or parallel edges.
Explicit vertices/positions, no implicit endpoint creation or relayout.
Exclusive graph authoring; captured independent Scene snapshots may be sampled concurrently.
Surviving object identities/paths/styles persist; surviving edges require explicit UpdateEdges after direct vertex changes.
Finite planar controls/deltas within 1e12 and bbox precision checks; malformed names/styles/topology rejected.
Count/name/paint/index/candidate storage and abstract work bounded; model is not RSS/cumulative allocation or CPU time.
Nil/empty batches still validate current state; unknown/duplicate requests fail atomically.
Existing captures/animations retain old topology; no background updater.

modified_legacy_source.changes: Retain original defaults/limits and identity stamps; delegate to bounded preflight; clone ID strings; add coordinate/precision checks. Original supported geometry arithmetic retained.
